items.title: Self-Publishing Platform Spines Raises $64 Million
items.excerpt: New AI-driven services have helped the company grow its revenue tenfold in the last two years, attracting further investment. Now, it’s changing its pitch from producing AI-produced books to helping authors publish with AI support.

items.title: Libraries, Publishers, and the Users We Both Serve
items.excerpt: Libraries and publishers can claim agency in the AI age by once again investigating and deeply understanding how our users work.

items.title: From AI Adoption to AI Practice: Building Governed AI in Scholarly Publishing
items.excerpt: How can a publisher make AI useful across the organization while keeping control of confidential information, editorial decisions, and accountability?

items.title: AI is changing book discovery — here's what booksellers can actually do
items.excerpt: When a reader asks ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity where to buy a book, make sure they get your answer, writes Simon Young.

items.title: Madras High Court orders FIR over fake, AI-generated books in public libraries
items.excerpt: The Madras High Court directed Tamil Nadu's vigilance directorate (DVAC) to register an FIR and freeze accounts over the Periyar library procurement of suspected AI-generated books by fake authors at inflated prices.

items.title: Archive of Our Own Outage Continues as Unauthorized AI Audiobook Sites Target Fanfiction Writers
items.excerpt: Archive of Our Own remains offline after a security breach as copycat sites exploit fanfiction through unauthorized AI-generated audiobooks.

items.title: A 'human touch': Why the audiobook industry still seeks voice actors over AI
items.excerpt: Producers primarily use AI to fill gaps in the audiobook industry, such as creating audio versions of books that would otherwise be considered commercially unviable.

items.title: Steins;Gate developer MAGES says AI translation is a long way from being viable for visual novels  - AUTOMATON WEST
items.excerpt: MAGES. CEO Makoto Asada says AI translation is still far from viable for text-heavy visual novels like Steins;Gate, where tone, wordplay and character voice carry the work.

items.title: I wrote an AI book using ChatGPT — is this method really the next chapter for aspiring authors?
items.excerpt: A New York Post reporter tries writing and publishing a book with ChatGPT to test whether AI-assisted self-publishing is a viable path for aspiring authors.

items.title: AI Tool of the Week: this Gemini feature brings textbooks into AI learning
items.excerpt: Gemini Notebook's textbook catalog lets students ask questions grounded in selected books, with citations to original passages, and turn chapters into study guides, quizzes and flashcards.

items.title: Sarah Huckabee Sanders mocked over suspected AI-generated photo promoting new book: ‘Those aren’t even real words!’
